# Sample records

A synthetic medrec records folder for the app’s demo mode and tests. Every person, organization and value in it is invented.

Copied from [own-your-health/app](https://github.com/own-your-health/app) `public/demo` at b16c4bd, with Jamie Example's dates moved 160 days earlier. The tests compare this connector's answers over it with `medrec mcp`'s (`test/golden/`).
